βάλοι: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’would let fall’ (κατὰ δάκρυ βάλοι ’would shed a tear’) · also in a wish, ’strike, hit’ + acc.: αἲ γὰρ … βάλοι ’would that he might strike’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἴθε: ’may he strike’ (αἴθ’ … βάλοι ’would that he strike’)
βιὸς: βιός — bow; masc. nom. sg. (oxytone, distinct from βίος ’life’)
καθεζόμενος: καθέζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting down’
κακοὶ: κακός — bad, base, common (of low birth); masc. nom. pl.
κατακτείνας: κατακτείνω — kill, slay (poetic for Attic ἀποκτείνω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having killed’
κόμπος: κόμπος — din, clatter, noise; masc. nom. sg.
μέλλεις: μέλλω — be about to, be likely to, be bound to; pres. 2 sg.
ξυλόχοιο: ξύλοχος — thicket, lair; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
οἰωνοὶ: οἰωνός — bird of prey, bird of omen; masc. nom. pl.
πάθω: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 1 sg., deliberative: ’what am I to suffer?’ (τί πάθω) · also aor. subj. 1 sg. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I may suffer’
πλάγχθη: πλάζω — drive off course, make wander; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was driven astray’
ποδός: πούς — foot; masc. gen. sg., gen. of the part seized: ’by the foot’
σφίσι: σφεῖς — they; dat. pl., epic σφίσι, often reflexive: ’to/for themselves’
ταρφέες: ταρφύς — thick, close-set, frequent; masc. nom. pl., epic -έες (= Attic -εῖς)
τιτυσκόμενος: τιτύσκομαι — aim at, take aim; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated: ’aiming’
ἀμπερὲς: ἀμπερές — right through, straight through; adv.
ἀνάλκιδος: ἄναλκις — without strength, cowardly, feeble; adj., masc. gen. sg.
ἁλώω: ἁλίσκομαι — be taken, be captured; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic lengthened vowel (= Attic ἁλῶ): ’I may be taken’
ἄφρων: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. nom. sg.
ἆτ: ἄατος (ἆτος) — insatiable; masc. voc. sg., elided (ἆτ’ = ἆτα, an unusual -α vocative), with the gen. δόλων ’insatiate of tricks’
ἐπαύρῃ: ἐπαυρίσκομαι — get, meet with (a good or ill); aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., after μή: ’lest you meet with’
ἐπιείσομαι: ἐπέρχομαι — go to, visit; fut. 1 sg. mid., from the εἶμι stem (ἐπι- + εἴσομαι)
ἐρύκακε: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist: ’checked’
ἐτάνυσσε: τανύω — stretch, draw out; aor. 3 sg., double σ metrical
ἰὸς: ἰός — arrow; masc. nom. sg. (not ἰός ’poison’)
ὀδυσσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. acc. sg., double-σ form (metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆα)
ὤλεσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’destroyed’
ὦκ: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (ὦκ’ = ὦκα)
